title: At this point I feel like AI companies selling Fear
excerpt: AI can do reasoning better But It can't outsmart humans , AI gets trained on data but human have their learning with them ,only about 5% of data a human share as learning, knowledge - rest it just inside us ,So technically AI can't replace human ,

AI can do reasoning better But It can't outsmart humans , AI gets trained on data but human have their learning with them ,only about 5% of data a human share as learning, knowledge - rest it just inside us ,So technically AI can't replace human ,

We do take inspiration , cross domain analysis and much diff things ,that a machine can't even do

So I feel like These AI companies are just selling fear just to promote their product , what are your thoughts on this
